summary: FrontView REIT filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $125 million of common stock. Approximately $50.7 million was already sold, leaving $74.3 million available. Sales occur via ordinary brokers' transactions or block trades at market prices; sales agents earn up to 2.0% commission. The filing also allows for forward sale agreements with multiple forward purchasers. This is a routine continuous offering under Rule 415, not a special situation.
